title: IELTS & TOEFL Speaking & Writing Skills

vocab.pt: Suavizar uma afirmação, evitar ser categórico

expressions.expr: Some people argue that..., while others believe...
expressions.meaning: Algumas pessoas argumentam que..., enquanto outras acreditam que...
expressions.example: Some people argue that social media connects us, while others believe it isolates us.
From my point of view, education should be free for everyone.
To sum up, both options have advantages and disadvantages.

expressions.meaning: Eu tenho a opinião de que...
expressions.example: I take the view that remote work benefits both employees and companies.

sentences: Some people argue that social media connects us, while others believe it isolates us.
From my point of view, education should be free for everyone.
To sum up, both options have advantages and disadvantages.
I take the view that remote work benefits both employees and companies.
It is widely believed that technology improves our quality of life.
Arguably, this is the most important issue of our time.
To some extent, I agree with this statement.
In summary, the evidence supports a balanced view.

grammar.title: Hedging Language & Paraphrasing (Suavizando Opiniões em Provas Orais e Escritas)
rules: Use expressões de "hedging" como "arguably/presumably/to some extent" para evitar afirmações absolutas e soar mais acadêmico: Arguably, this is the most important issue of our time.
Introduza opiniões com estruturas indiretas como "It is widely believed that..." em vez de afirmações diretas: It is widely believed that technology improves our quality of life.
Para parafrasear a pergunta antes de responder (comum no IELTS Speaking), reformule com sinônimos: "Do you enjoy your job?" → "As for my career, I find it quite fulfilling."
Para concluir de forma clara em redações e respostas orais, use "To sum up / In summary / To conclude": To sum up, both options have advantages and disadvantages.

To sum up, both options have merit.
